title: zygia juruana
intro: Zygia juruana, commonly known as the "Monkey's Brush," is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. The health benefits of Zygia juruana include its potential to reduce inflammation and fight against certain types of cancer, attributed to its antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which have been traditionally used to treat wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Zygia juruana include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
